article.headline: Mavericks host Jazz Friday for NBA Cup group stage game
article.description: Utah Jazz (1-7, 15th in the Western Conference) vs. Dallas Mavericks (4-4, 11th in the Western Conference)
article.title: Mavericks host Jazz Friday for NBA Cup group stage game
article.linkText: Mavericks host Jazz Friday for NBA Cup group stage game
article.story: Utah Jazz (1-7, 15th in the Western Conference) vs. Dallas Mavericks (4-4, 11th in the Western Conference) Dallas; Friday, 8 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: The Utah Jazz travel to play the Utah Jazz in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. Dallas finished 26-56 overall, 14-37 in Western Conference play and 16-25 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Mavericks allowed opponents to score 119.6 points per game and shoot 47.8% from the field last season. Utah finished 22-60 overall and 12-40 in Western Conference games during the 2025-26 season. The Jazz averaged 117.6 points per game while shooting 46.7% from the field and 34.5% from 3-point distance last season. INJURIES: Mavericks: Max Christie: day to day (hip), Santi Aldama: day to day (knee), Tarik Biberovic: day to day (heel), Sergio De Larrea: out (knee), Dereck Lively II: day to day (foot). Jazz: Jusuf Nurkic: out (foot), Jaren Jackson Jr.: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
